arxiv-2103-02135.title: Robert X. J. Hao
arxiv-2103-02135.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . Combinatorial proofs of the Ramanujan type congruences modulo 3 Abstract. The partition statistic V_{R} -rank is introduced to give combinatorial proofs of the Ramanujan type congruences mod 3 for certain classes of partition functions. Keywords : partition statistic; bijection; combinatorial proof; Ramanujan type congruence; AMS Classifications : 05A17, 11P83 1 Introduction A partition \lambda of a positive integer n is a weakly-decreasing sequence of positive integers \lambda_{1}\geq\lambda_{2}\geq\ldots\geq\lambda_{l} such that |\lambda|=\sum_{i=1}^{l}\lambda_{i}=n .

arxiv-2111-06246.description: Abstract The magnetic nature of low dimensional compound, CrCl 3 , was investigated by muon spin rotation, relaxation and resonance ( μ + \mu^{+} SR). The μ + \mu^{+} SR measurements revealed three distinct phases as a function of temperature: an antiferromagnetic state (AF) for T ≤ T N = 14.32 ​ ( 6 ) T\leq T_{\rm N}=14.

arxiv-2201-00389.title: A Normal Graph Algebra
arxiv-2201-00389.creator: Harold N. Ward
arxiv-2201-00389.description: Abstract . We define a normal graph algebra modeled on algebras used in genetics. Although the algebra does not always determine its graph, it often highlights special features. After developing basic properties of the algebra, we examine those of certain minimal graphs. We then apply the results to the Petersen graph, finding connections between some of its many aspects.

arxiv-2202-12886.title: Indefinite causal order with fixed temporal order for electrons and positrons
arxiv-2202-12886.creator: Aurélien Drezet 1
arxiv-2202-12886.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Aurélien Drezet 1. We provide an analysis of indefinite causal orders in relativistic quantum mechanics based on the electron-positron picture of Feynman involving negative energy electrons moving backward in time. We show that genuine implementations of the paradigmatic quantum switch, but here violating some causal inequalities and with a fixed temporal order, become possible in extreme external electromagnetic field conditions allowing the presence of closed time-like curves. arxiv-2302-11697.title: Möbius boron–nitride nanobelts interacting with heavy metal nanoclusters
arxiv-2302-11697.creator: C. Aguiar 1, N. Dattani 2,3, I. Camps 1,3
arxiv-2302-11697.description: Abstract How do nickel, cadmium, and lead nanoclusters interact with boron-nitride and Mobius-type boron-nitride nanobelts? To answer this question, we used the semiempirical tight binding framework, as implemented in the xTB software, to determine the lowest energy geometries, binding energy, complexes stability, and electronic properties.

arxiv-2412-16656.title: Generalizable Articulated Object Perception with Superpoints
arxiv-2412-16656.creator: Qiaojun Yu, Ce Hao, Xibin Yuan, Li Zhang, Liu Liu, Yukang Huo, Rohit Agarwal, Cewu Lu
arxiv-2412-16656.description: Abstract Manipulating articulated objects with robotic arms is challenging due to the complex kinematic structure, which requires precise part segmentation for efficient manipulation. In this work, we introduce a novel superpoint-based perception method designed to improve part segmentation in 3D point clouds of articulated objects.

arxiv-2502-16931.title: Machine learning and high dimensional vector search
arxiv-2502-16931.creator: Matthijs Douze, Meta FAIR
arxiv-2502-16931.description: Abstract Machine learning and vector search are two research topics that developed in parallel in nearby communities. However, unlike many other fields related to big data, machine learning has not significantly impacted vector search. In this opinion paper we attempt to explain this oddity. Along the way, we wander over the numerous bridges between the two fields.

arxiv-2505-06087.title: Deep Diffusion Maps
arxiv-2505-06087.creator: Sergio García-Heredia, Carlos M. Alaíz, Ángela Fernández
arxiv-2505-06087.description: Abstract Abstract One of the fundamental problems within the field of machine learning is dimensionality reduction. Dimensionality reduction methods make it possible to combat the so-called curse of dimensionality, visualize high-dimensional data and, in general, improve the efficiency of storing and processing large data sets. One of the best-known nonlinear dimensionality reduction methods is Diffusion Maps.

arxiv-2505-22368.title: AgentDNS: A Root Domain Naming System for LLM Agents
arxiv-2505-22368.creator: Enfang Cui, Yujun Cheng, Rui She, Dan Liu, Zhiyuan Liang, Minxin Guo, Tianzheng Li, Qian Wei, Wenjuan Xing, Zhijie Zhong
arxiv-2505-22368.description: Abstract The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has highlighted critical challenges in cross-vendor service discovery, interoperability, and communication. Existing protocols like model context protocol and agent-to-agent protocol have made significant strides in standardizing interoperability between agents and tools, as well as communication among multi-agents.

arxiv-2506-21281.title: Playing Snake on a Graph
arxiv-2506-21281.creator: Denise Graafsma, Bodo Manthey, Alexander Skopalik
arxiv-2506-21281.description: Abstract Snake is a classic computer game, which has been around for decades. Based on this game, we study the game of Snake on arbitrary undirected graphs. A snake forms a simple path that has to move to an apple while avoiding colliding with itself. When the snake reaches the apple, it grows longer, and a new apple appears.

arxiv-2507-06360.title: Pyrosome: Verified Compilation for Modular Metatheory CCS: Software and its engineering General programming languages CCS: Social and professional topics History of programming languages
arxiv-2507-06360.creator: Dustin Jamner, Gabriel Kammer, Ritam Nag, Adam Chlipala
arxiv-2507-06360.description: Abstract . We present Pyrosome, 1 1 1 Pyrosomes are tiny colonial organisms that connect to each other to form tube-shaped colonies up to 60 feet in length. In our framework, compilers are similarly made up of many small, independent components.

arxiv-2511-06822.title: A PDE perspective on the flat chain conjecture
arxiv-2511-06822.creator: Andrea Marchese
arxiv-2511-06822.description: Abstract This survey summarizes recent progress on the flat chain conjecture, which asserts the equivalence between metric currents and flat chains with finite mass in the Euclidean space. In particular, we focus on recent work showing that the conjecture is equivalent to a Lipschitz regularity estimate for a certain PDE.

arxiv-2602-11263.title: The X17 with Chiral Couplings
arxiv-2602-11263.creator: Max H. Fieg, Toni Mäkelä, Tim M.P. Tait, Miša Toman
arxiv-2602-11263.description: Abstract In recent years, the ATOMKI collaboration has performed a series of measurements of excited nuclei, observing a resonant excess of electron-positron pairs at large opening angles compared to the Standard Model prediction. The excess has been hypothesized to be due to the production of a new spin-1 or spin-0 particle, X17, with a mass of about 17 MeV.

pmc-10736966.title: OPIOID PRESCRIBING AND OPIOID USE IN OLDER ADULTS: BUILDING AND REFINING A CHANGE PACKAGE FOR PRIMARY CARE
pmc-10736966.creator: Ellen Childs, Megan Noel, Clarissa Hsu, Michael Parchman, Kendall Hall, Sarah Shoemaker-Hunt, Nicole Keane
pmc-10736966.description: Opioid use is associated with increased risk of harms in older adults (≥65) due to physiologic changes, drug interactions, and comorbidities. The AHRQ Opioids in Older Adults project developed a change package based on an evidence review and expert recommendations that included nine high-leverage changes (HLCs) and related key activities to address safe opioid use in this population.

pmc-11377289.title: Arabidopsis TIC236 contributes to proplastid development and chloroplast biogenesis during embryogenesis
pmc-11377289.creator: Mei Liu, Lifen Chen, Shijie Gu, Aiwei Zhang, Mengjuan Tong, Shuailei Wang, Juntao Wang, Yirui Zhu, Jingsheng Zhang, Yu Sun, Yi Guo, Rui Li
pmc-11377289.description: Plastids are essential, semi-autonomous organelles in plants that carry out a multitude of functions during development. Plastids existing in different subtypes are derived from proplastids progenitors and interconvert in response to environmental and growth cues. Most efforts focus on the differentiation from proplastid to other forms.

pmc-11430209.title: Are ultrasonographic scoring systems of the salivary gland in primary Sjögren’s syndrome suitable for examination of Type2 diabetes mellitus patients with sicca?
pmc-11430209.creator: Abdulvahap Kahveci, Alper Gümüştepe, İsmihan Sunar, Şebnem Ataman
pmc-11430209.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to compare the salivary gland ultrasonography(SGUS) findings in patients with primary Sjögren’s Syndrome (pSS) and diabetes mellitus(DM) patients with sicca symptoms and to examine the relationship between salivary gland ultrasonography (SGUS) findings with clinical and laboratory parameters.MethodsIn this study, 34 patients with pSS and 34 DM patients with sicca symptoms were included.

pmc-11499158.title: High prevalence of long COVID in anti-TPO positive euthyroid individuals with strongly elevated SARS-CoV-2-specific T cell responses and moderately raised anti-spike IgG levels 23 months post-infection
pmc-11499158.creator: Zsolt Matula, Viktória Király, Gabriella Bekő, Márton Gönczi, András Zóka, Róbert Steinhauser, Ferenc Uher, István Vályi-Nagy
pmc-11499158.description: IntroductionSevere acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus type 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection, the causative agent of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), causes post-acute infection syndrome in a surprisingly large number of cases worldwide. This condition, also known as long COVID or post-acute sequelae of COVID-19, is characterized by extremely complex symptoms and pathology.

pmc-11561455.title: SeqVerify: An accessible analysis tool for cell line genomic integrity, contamination, and gene editing outcomes
pmc-11561455.creator: Merrick Pierson Smela, Valerio Pepe, Steven Lubbe, Evangelos Kiskinis, George M Church
pmc-11561455.description: SummaryOver the last decade, advances in genome editing and pluripotent stem cell (PSC) culture have let researchers generate edited PSC lines to study a wide variety of biological questions. However, abnormalities in cell lines such as aneuploidy, mutations, on-target and off-target editing errors, and microbial contamination can arise during PSC culture or due to undesired editing outcomes.

pmc-11632366.title: A data-driven framework for biomarker discovery applied to optimizing modern clinical and preclinical trials on Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11632366.creator: Isaac Llorente-Saguer, Neil P Oxtoby
pmc-11632366.description: PET is used to measure tau protein accumulation in Alzheimer’s disease. Multiple biomarkers have been proposed to track disease progression, most notably the standardized uptake value ratio of PET tracer uptake in a target region of interest relative to a reference region, but literature suggests these region choices are nontrivial.

pmc-12466238.title: Heritability of neonatal acute phase protein levels
pmc-12466238.creator: Hugo Sjöqvist, Martin Brynge, Kristiina Tammimies, Ralf Kuja-Halkola, Sven Bölte, Christina Dalman, Renee M. Gardner, Håkan Karlsson
pmc-12466238.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Levels of neonatal Acute Phase Proteins (APPs) have been associated with autism and schizophrenia. The relative contributions of genetic and environmental factors to variation in APP levels in the neonatal period are not known. Therefore, we used one of the largest twin samples to date to map the proportions of heritable and non-heritable factors to variations in APPs measured shortly after birth.

pmc-12932306.title: Extended CTA scan range for early detection of left atrial and left atrial appendage thrombus and other filling defects in acute ischemic stroke
pmc-12932306.creator: Juan Marta-Enguita, Sara Biain, Diego Ayuso, Sergio Vasquez-Ferreccio, Cristina del Bosque, Patricia de la Riva, Noemí Diez, Felix Gonzalez, Ana de Arce, Jon Equiza, Gorka Arenaza, Virginia Gomez-Usabiaga, Maite Martinez‑Zabaleta
pmc-12932306.description: BackgroundThe left atrium (LA) and left atrial appendage (LAA) are common sites of thrombus formation leading to cardioembolic stroke. We aimed to include LA/LAA in acute-phase stroke CT angiography (CTA) to detect potential embolic sources early.MethodsThe CTA scan range was extended to include the LA/LAA.
